blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speech-to-speech systems must solve tasks whose requirements emerge across conversational turns. We introduce SpeechConversationBench (SCB), a focused evaluation of spoken mathematical reasoning using a pool of 103 sharded GSM8K problems. The framework compares the original problem delivered in one turn ( Full ), its concatenated information shards delivered together ( Concat ), and incremental spoken disclosure across turns ( Sharded ). We report final-answer accuracies for four commercial speech systems and LEGO, a proprietary speech pipeline developed internally by the SCBX Innovation Lab team, with explicit conversational context management. Relative to Concat , Sharded accuracy decreases by 5.0-25.3 percentage points across the four commercial systems. LEGO attains 77.5% in all three conditions, compared with 76.6% Sharded accuracy for GPT-4o Realtime. Both single-turn baselines are needed to distinguish sensitivity to reformulation from the challenges of incremental interaction.
blocks.zh: 语音对语音系统必须解决在对话回合中产生要求的任务。 我们介绍SpeechConversation Bench(SCB),这是利用103个已磨损的GSM8K问题集合对口语数学推理的集中评价. 该框架比较了原先一个回合(全面)交付的问题、其合并信息块(Concat)交付的问题和跨回合(Sharded)逐步公开的问题。 我们报告四个商业语音系统和LEGO的最终解答程序,这是SCBX创新实验室团队内部开发的专有语音管道,有明确的对话背景管理。 相对于康卡特(Concat),Sharded精度在四个商业系统中下降了5.0~25.3个百分点. 最不发达国家专家组达到 在所有三个条件中均占77.5%,而GPT-4o Realtime的精度为76.6%. 需要两个单回合基线来区分对重构的敏感性和增量互动的挑战。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Related Work
blocks.zh: 1 导言和有关工作

blocks.en: Solving a complete spoken request does not establish that a system can solve the same task when relevant facts arrive over several turns. Mathematical word problems provide a focused test: success requires integrating incrementally disclosed quantities and constraints into a verifiable final answer.
blocks.zh: 解决一个完整的口头请求并不能确定当相关事实经过几个回合到达时,一个系统能够解决同样的任务. 数学字问题提供了一个重点测试:成功需要将渐进披露的数量和限制纳入可核查的最终答案。

blocks.en: VoiceBench evaluates voice assistants across content, speaker, and environmental variations [ 1 ] , while Dynamic-SUPERB organizes diverse instruction-based speech tasks [ 6 ] . Multi-turn speech evaluation is also an established research direction. MTalk-Bench combines pairwise and rubric-based assessment across semantic, paralinguistic, and ambient-sound dimensions [ 4 ] . Audio MultiChallenge evaluates natural spoken interactions involving memory, instruction retention, self-coherence, and spoken repairs [ 5 ] . SpeechConversationBench complements these broader evaluations with a narrower comparison: numerical task completion under three presentations of corresponding problem information. It does not measure their full range of acoustic or interactional capabilities.
blocks.zh: Voice Bench在内容,扬声器,环境变化等方面评价语音助理[1],而Dynamic-SUPERB则组织多种基于教学的语音任务[6]. 多回合语音评价也是既定的研究方向. MTalk-Bench在语义、语言学和环境声波维度方面结合了对称和基于主题的评估 [4]. Audio MultiChallenge评价自然的口语互动,涉及记忆、指令保留、自我协调以及口语修复[5]。 Bench用较窄的比较来补充这些更广泛的评价:在对相应问题信息的三次介绍下完成数字任务。 它不测量它们的全部声学或相互作用能力。

blocks.en: We adapt the Full / Concat / Sharded protocol of Laban et al. [ 7 ] to spoken mathematical tasks. LoCoMo instead evaluates memory over extended, multi-session conversations [ 9 ] ; our setting concerns integrating the facts of one problem within an interaction.
blocks.zh: 我们修改了Laban等人的 Full / Concat / Sharted 协议。 [7] 去讲数学任务。 LoCoMo则通过扩展的多会对话来评价内存[9];我们的设定涉及将一个问题的事实纳入互动。

blocks.en: Moshi models full-duplex speech-text dialogue [ 3 ] , while MemGPT manages information across memory tiers [ 10 ] . Context-aware decoding strengthens adherence to spoken history [ 8 ] . These approaches motivate our comparison of five speech systems, including the context-managing cascade LEGO; they do not validate LEGO itself.
blocks.zh: Moshi模型全复式语音文本对话框[3],而MemGPT管理跨内存层级的信息[10]. 背景感解码强化了对口语历史的坚持[8]. 这些办法促使我们比较五个语音系统,包括上下文管理级联LEGO;它们不能验证LEGO本身。

blocks.en: 2 Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 2. 评价框架

blocks.en: 2.1 Task and Input Conditions
blocks.zh: 2.1 任务和投入条件

blocks.en: The problem pool contains 103 mathematical word problems from the sharded GSM8K resource of Laban et al. [ 7 ] . GSM8K contains grade-school problems requiring multi-step numerical reasoning [ 2 ] . A shard is a partial statement of a problem’s information; the shards jointly specify the task. Spoken prompts provide the input, and correctness of the final spoken answer is the evaluation target. Figure 1 summarizes the conditions; Figure 2 shows the original simulator.
blocks.zh: 问题池包含103个数学词问题,来自Laban等人被磨损的GSM8K资源. [7]. GSM8K包含需要多步数推理的年级问题[2]. 硬盘是对问题信息的部分说明;硬盘共同规定了任务. 语录提示提供了投入,最终口语回答的正确性是评价目标. 图1汇总了条件;图2显示了原始模拟器.

blocks.en: In Full , the original complete problem is presented in one spoken turn. In Concat , the corresponding shards are combined and presented together in a single turn. In Sharded , information is disclosed incrementally through a multi-turn spoken exchange. Thus, Full and Concat differ in formulation, while Concat and Sharded differ in how the shard content is distributed through interaction. This follows the conceptual controls of the original text protocol [ 7 ] without assuming that its model settings transfer to speech.
blocks.zh: 在Full中,最初的完整问题以一个口号呈现. 在Concat 中,对应的硬块被组合在一起,以单转的形式呈现. 在Sharded中,信息通过多回合口语交流逐步披露。 因此,Full和Concat在配制上有所不同,而Concat和Sharded在通过相互作用如何分配硬性内容方面则有所不同. 这遵循了原始文本协议[7]的概念控制,而不假定其模式设置会转移到语音.

blocks.en: The Concat baseline is especially useful because reformulation can itself change difficulty. Comparing Sharded only with Full can conflate that change with the effect of incremental disclosure. Nevertheless, Concat versus Sharded is not an isolation of memory alone: assistant responses, speech processing, and the evolving conversational trajectory may also contribute to the observed difference.
blocks.zh: Concat基线特别有用,因为重塑本身可以改变难度. 只有将Sharded与Full相比较,才能将这一变化与渐进披露的效果混为一谈。 不过,Concat对 Sharded不仅仅是记忆的孤立:助理响应,语音处理,以及不断发展的谈话轨迹也可能促进观察到的差异.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Spoken evaluation conditions. Full and Concat present information together; Sharded distributes it across an exchange. Final spoken answers are assessed for numerical correctness.
blocks.zh: 图1:评价条件。 完整而凝聚的信息一起呈现;Sharded通过一个交换来分配. 对最后的口头答复进行数字正确性评估。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Sharded-conversation simulator reproduced from Laban et al. [ 7 ] . This reference architecture motivates the spoken adaptation; it does not specify our audio-processing or scoring components.
blocks.zh: 图2:从Laban等人复制的硬化-对话模拟器。 [7]. 这个参考架构激发了口语改编;它没有指定我们的音频处理或评分组件.

blocks.en: 2.2 Systems and Outcome Measures
blocks.zh: 2.2 制度和结果措施

blocks.en: We evaluate GPT-4o Realtime, GPT-4o Mini Realtime, Gemini 2.5 Flash Live, and Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview Native Audio Dialog, alongside LEGO. These names identify the systems in the reported comparison; they do not establish exact API snapshots. LEGO is a proprietary pipeline developed internally by the SCBX Innovation Lab team. It combines automatic speech recognition (ASR), a large language model (LLM) with explicit context management, and text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis, with all component models self-hosted internally. The pipeline incorporates the Thai semantic end-of-turn detection method described by Popit et al. [11] . Its context mechanism summarizes conversational history and reintroduces relevant information at successive turns. This is a system-level comparison rather than a controlled test of any individual component.
blocks.zh: 我们评价GPT-4o Realtime,GPT-4o Mini Realtime,双子座2.5 Flash Live,和双子座2.5 Flash Preview 原生音频对话框,与LEGO并列. 这些名称在报告的比较中标明了系统;它们没有建立准确的API快照. LEGO是由SCBX创新实验室团队内部开发的专有管道. 它结合了自动语音识别(ASR),一个具有明确上下文管理的大型语言模型(LLM),以及文本对语音(TTS)的合成,所有组件模型都由内部自行托管. 管道采用了Popit等人描述的泰国语义终端检测方法。 [11]. 其上下文机制总结了对话历史,并在相继转折时重新引入相关信息. 这是系统层面的比较,而不是对任何单个组件的对照测试。

blocks.en: Let A F A_{F} , A C A_{C} , and A S A_{S} denote the reported percentages of correct final answers under Full , Concat , and Sharded . We summarize the multi-turn contrast by an absolute change and a normalized retention ratio: Δ S − C = A S − A C , R S / C = 100 ​ A S A C . \Delta_{S-C}=A_{S}-A_{C},\qquad R_{S/C}=100\,\frac{A_{S}}{A_{C}}. A retention value of 100% means equal aggregate accuracies, not that every problem has the same outcome. All derived quantities use the displayed accuracies and are rounded to one decimal place. The 103-problem pool is distinct from the per-condition trial denominators and repeat counts, which are not specified in the aggregate results. Consequently, we do not infer correct-answer counts or uncertainty intervals from that pool size.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports all five systems. Among the commercial systems, Sharded accuracy ranges from 46.6% to 76.6%, and every system scores lower in Sharded than in Concat . The absolute decreases are 5.0 pp for GPT-4o Realtime, 25.3 pp for GPT-4o Mini Realtime, 15.5 pp for Gemini 2.5 Flash Live, and 25.0 pp for Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview Native Audio Dialog. These correspond to retention ratios of 93.9%, 67.4%, 75.0%, and 68.8%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1报告所有五个系统。 在商业系统中,Sharded精度在46.6%至76.6%之间,每个系统在Sharded的分数都低于Concat的分数. 绝对下降的有:GPT-4o Realtime的5.0pp,GPT-4o Mini Realtime的25.3pp,双子座2.5 Flash Live的15.5pp,和双子座2.5 Flash Preview本地音频对话框的25.0pp. 这分别是93.9%、67.4%、75.0%和68.8%的留用率。

blocks.en: Table 1: Final-answer accuracy (%) under each input condition. Δ S − C \Delta_{S-C} is the Sharded -minus- Concat change in percentage points; R S / C R_{S/C} is aggregate accuracy retention (%). Derived columns use the displayed accuracies. Bold marks the highest Sharded accuracy without implying significance.
blocks.zh: 表1:每个输入条件的最后回答准确度(%)。 S – C – Delta – C – C – C – C – C – C – 是 Sharded - 减去- Concat 的百分点变化; R S / C R – S / C – C – C – C – C – C – C – C – C – C – C – C – C – C – C = 总体精度保留 (%). 衍生列使用显示的快度 。 粗体标出最高的Sharded精度而不暗示意义.

blocks.en: GPT-4o Realtime improves from 70.0% in Full to 76.6% in Sharded , even though it falls from 81.6% in Concat . A Full -only comparison would therefore conceal its disadvantage relative to the concatenated-shard baseline. More generally, the Concat -minus- Full changes are + 11.6 +11.6 , + 2.2 +2.2 , + 7.7 +7.7 , and − 5.0 -5.0 pp for the four commercial systems, respectively. Both single-turn controls are therefore informative; degradation is not universal across baseline choices.
blocks.zh: GPT-4o Realtime从完全的70.0%提高到了Sharded的76.6%,尽管从康卡特的81.6%下降到了. 因此,仅作全面比较,就可掩盖相对于压缩-硬基线的不利之处。 更一般地说,Concat - minus - 完全变化分别是+11.6+11.6,+2.2+2.2,+7.7+7.7,以及−5.0-5.0 pp四个商业系统. 因此,两种单回合控制都提供了信息;在基线选择中,退化并不普遍。

blocks.en: Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview Native Audio Dialog has the highest Full accuracy, 85.0%, but achieves 55.0% in Sharded . GPT-4o Realtime has lower Full accuracy yet the strongest Sharded result among the commercial systems. Selecting a system by single-turn accuracy can therefore favor a different system than selecting by multi-turn accuracy.
blocks.zh: 双子座2.5闪光预览原生音频对话框全精度最高,85.0%,但在Sharded实现55.0%. GPT-4o Realtime的全精度较低,但却是商业系统中最强的Sharted结果. 因此,通过单转精度选择一个系统,比通过多转精度选择一个不同的系统更有利.

blocks.en: LEGO obtains 77.5% in all three conditions and the highest observed Sharded score, exceeding GPT-4o Realtime by 0.9 pp. Its zero aggregate change makes explicit context management worth investigating, but does not show that summarization caused the result. The systems differ in their components, and no memory ablation is available. Equal aggregate scores could also conceal problems that become correct and others that become incorrect. We therefore interpret LEGO as a promising system-level observation, not proof that a cascade is generally superior to native audio modeling.
blocks.zh: 专家组获得 在所有三个条件和观测到的最高的Sharded分数中77.5%,超过GPT-4o Realtime0.9pp. 其零总变化使上下文管理明确值得调查,但并未表明总和导致结果。 系统组件不同,没有内存衰减。 相等的总分还可能掩盖一些变得正确的问题和另一些变得不正确的问题。 因此,我们把LEGO解释为一种有希望的系统层面观察,而不是证明级联一般优于本土音频模型.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion, Limitations, and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论、限制和结论

blocks.en: The observed multi-turn gaps do not identify a failure mechanism. A wrong numerical answer can arise from misperception, loss or misuse of earlier information, arithmetic error, or answer rendering. Without intermediate transcripts and matched interventions, these explanations cannot be separated. The table establishes neither forgetting nor monotonic degradation with turn count.
blocks.zh: 所观察到的多回合差距并不能确定一个失败机制。 错误的数值答案可能源于对早期信息的误解,丢失或滥用,算术错误,或答案渲染. 没有中间记录和相应的发言,这些解释就无法分开。 该表既不是遗忘,也不是单调退化,并用转弯计数。

blocks.en: This small mathematical evaluation does not measure open-domain or multilingual dialogue, interruptions, prosody, noise robustness, latency, speech naturalness, or memory-management cost. The aggregate record does not specify exact model snapshots, audio-generation settings, sampling parameters, per-condition denominators, repeat counts, or answer-extraction and scoring details. LEGO’s component identities and memory-update implementation are also unspecified. These omissions limit reproduction and statistical interpretation.
blocks.zh: 这种小的数学评价不测量开放域或多语言的对话,中断,发音,噪声稳健,耐久,语音自然,或内存管理成本. 汇总记录没有指定精确的模型快照,音频生成设置,采样参数,每个条件分母,重复计数,或回答-提取和评分细节. LEGO的组件身份和内存更新执行情况也没有说明。 这些遗漏限制了复制和统计解释。

blocks.en: A matched text-only baseline is needed to quantify an audio-specific penalty. To test whether LEGO’s context mechanism is responsible for its observed stability, the informative comparison would hold recognition, reasoning, and synthesis components fixed while varying context summarization. Problem-level outcomes and repeated runs would then support paired comparisons and uncertainty estimates. Such evidence would distinguish improvements in remembering information from improvements in using it, a distinction also raised by work on context-aware decoding [ 8 ] . Broader spoken benchmarks remain necessary to assess whether gains in numerical correctness extend to natural interaction.
blocks.zh: 需要有匹配的文本基准,以量化特定音频处罚。 为了检验LEGO的上下文机制是否负责其观察到的稳定性,信息比较将固定识别、推理和合成部分,同时对上下文进行不同的归纳。 问题层面的结果和重复运行将支持配对比较和不确定性估计。 这种证据可以把对信息记忆的改进与对信息的利用的改进区分开来,关于上下文解码的工作也提出了这种区分[8]。 要评估数字正确性的收益是否扩大到自然互动,仍有必要采用更广泛的通用基准。

blocks.en: SpeechConversationBench compares spoken mathematical task completion across original, consolidated, and incrementally disclosed inputs. All four commercial systems lose accuracy from Concat to Sharded , whereas LEGO preserves its reported aggregate accuracy. The strongest supported lesson is methodological: retain both single-turn controls and report absolute task accuracy alongside the multi-turn change.
blocks.zh: 演讲 法官组比较了所有原始、合并和逐步披露的投入的口头数学任务完成情况。 所有四个商业系统都从Concat到Sharded都失去了准确性,而LEGO则保留了所报告的合计准确性。 得到支持的最强有力的经验教训是方法:既保留单回合控制,又报告绝对任务准确性,同时进行多回合变革。
